answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The signal edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 41 clones produces a signature the meadow analysis flags immediately. An attacker must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the zephyr settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
